title: Canonical quotient map, prime and finite presentation
statement: Given a field k, an R=k[x_1,...,x_d]-algebra C finitely presented over R, φ:R→Λ, a compatible map γ:C→Λ and a prime q whose localized maximal ideal is generated by the φ(x_i), and c≥1, construct the induced map γ₀:C/JC→Λ/JΛ and a quotient prime q₀ contracting to q, with C/JC finitely presented over R/J, where J=(x_i^(8c)). No regularity, dimension or separability assumption is required.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 07FE (lemma-resolve-special), final powered-parameter reduction

proof.text: Each parameter belongs to q by the maximal-ideal contraction lemma, so its powered ideal JΛ is contained in q. The algebra-map identity for γ shows JC maps into JΛ. Construct γ₀ with Ideal.quotientMap and q₀ as the ideal image under the quotient map. The quotient-map lemmas prove compatibility, primeness and contraction.
The quotient of C is finite type over R and therefore over R/J by restriction of scalars. R/J is Noetherian; Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType gives finite presentation.

theorem parameter_quotient_data
    {k : Type u} {C : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing C] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    (d c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k →ₐ[k] Λ)
    [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C]
    [FinitePresentation (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C]
    (γ : letI := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra; C →ₐ[MvPolynomial (Fin d) k] Λ)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin d ↦
      algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)))) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) :
    letI := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    let J : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) :=
      Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin d ↦ (MvPolynomial.X i ^ c) ^ 8))
    let J_C := Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C) J
    let J_Λ := Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) Λ) J
    ∃ (_ : FinitePresentation (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k ⧸ J) (C ⧸ J_C))
      (γ₀ : (C ⧸ J_C) →ₐ[MvPolynomial (Fin d) k ⧸ J] (Λ ⧸ J_Λ))
      (q₀ : PrimeSpectrum (Λ ⧸ J_Λ)),
      γ₀.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_C) =
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_Λ).comp γ.toRingHom ∧
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_Λ) q₀ = q
